source_instruction: i'm looking for 1 resealed bag of puffed snacks
query:
Oh man, I just got stuck waiting for the crosswalk light for a full five minutes because a group of baby geese decided to waddle straight across the intersection right in front of a line of cars, and every driver was totally stopped just grinning and watching them instead of honking. The mom goose was hissing at a cyclist who got too close trying to snap a photo, and one tiny gosling kept tripping over its own feet and falling into the curb grass before scrambling to catch up. I swear that little detour made me almost miss the pre-work window to grab the stuff I came here for, and now I’m rushing a little because I still have to swing by the coffee shop before I head into the office.
Hey, can you help me grab a breakfast food from this section for me? I need it to come in a self-sealing can, I want that one I always pick, and make sure it’s under $30, oh and also it has to be certified kosher for Passover even though I don’t keep that dietary rule at all, I just like the little sticker on the packaging. Wait, no, hold on, actually just make sure it fits those things I said, yeah?
